name: DejaBrew
source:
A short simple VN about a waiter with a propensity for terrible puns. Sip on something sweet, calming, and silly. 🍵

[From [url=https://heartofsins.itch.io/dejabrew-by-baguetti]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部簡單的短篇視覺小說，講述一個總愛講很冷的諧音笑話的服務生。來點甜甜的、舒緩的、傻氣的飲品吧。🫖

[來源：[url=https://heartofsins.itch.io/dejabrew-by-baguetti]Itch.io[/url]]
